2.

The case of the petitioners is that the lands of the petitioners are situated at various villages under East Kameng, District, were acquired for construction of Foot Track from Lamnio to Langchu (from 0.00 to KM 60.514).

Circulars for survey/verification, assessment of properties were issued and cancelled time and again and, ultimately, bills were prepared without any site visits and almost about 70% of the land compensation was paid to 21 persons who were not the land owners and not affected by the project in question without any basis.

It is the case of the petitioners that after the petitioners approached the Deputy Commissioner, Seppa, survey and field visits were done and only 30% of the compensation amount was paid to the petitioners.

However, the said compensation was not based on any market rate of land, solatium, interest and multiplication factor as mandated under the Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and ReSettlement Act, 2013.

opennyai_summary.facts:
This application under Article 226 of the Constitution of India has been filed by the petitioners with the following prayers:-
I. Directing the Deputy Commissioner/Collector, Seppa, East Kameng District,
Arunachal Pradesh to pay land compensation to the petitioners as per the provisions of RFC&TLARR Act, 2013;
It is the case of the petitioners that after the petitioners approached the Deputy Commissioner, Seppa, survey and field visits were done and only 30% of the compensation amount was paid to the petitioners.
However, the said compensation was not based on any market rate of land, solatium, interest and multiplication factor as mandated under the Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and ReSettlement Act, 2013.
Therefore, the petitioners contended that they have been denied their rightful land value and compensation accordingly.
